specs.scene: Overhead flat-lay of a warehouse loading-dock counter, a hard hat and folded high-visibility vest at one corner, a coiled headset cable, a stack of laminated safety checklists overlapping at the edges, a tablet lying flat with its screen blank and reflective, a pallet-jack key ring, a clipboard holding a sign-off sheet with a ballpoint pen resting across it, a box cutter, shipping boxes with blank labels pushed to the frame edges, one hand entering from the bottom edge pressing a thumb onto the sign-off sheet, objects dense to all four edges with small bare patches of counter visible between them.
specs.source_quote: Training modules, product demos, onboarding, sales explainers

recognisable.why: Hard hat, vest, clipboard and pallet-jack key are everyday trade objects instantly readable, though not a household brand.

legibility.why: The flat-lay's density means several objects must be individually resolved to grasp the training-station idea, costing some clarity.

curiosity.why: Trained, not filmed states a verdict the viewer cannot confirm by looking and wants explained.

subject.why: No single human or object anchor; the vest and hat compete for attention rather than anchoring the frame.

credible.why: No figure is carried, which is the full-credit condition.

stakes.why: Implies a real operational change for the viewer's own onboarding costs, though indirectly.

reexpress.why: The overlay reframes the title's filming claim as a training outcome rather than repeating it.

specs.scene: A documentary photograph of an empty corporate training room in flat morning light, rows of vacant chairs facing a wall-mounted screen glowing with diffuse blank light, a projector cart to one side, a stack of blank handout folders on the front table, no people in frame.

recognisable.why: A training room with chairs and a screen is a familiar corporate environment but not a distinctive named subject.

legibility.why: The empty room reads as one coherent scene even though several chairs are present as texture.

curiosity.why: The caption asserts a verdict about who ran the class that cannot be resolved from the photo alone.

subject.why: The blank screen serves as a single distinctive object anchor in the absence of a person.

credible.why: No figure is carried, satisfying the full-credit condition.

reexpress.why: The verdict adds a consequence the title's mechanism does not state, without repeating its terms.

specs.scene: A single professional video camera mounted on a tripod in an otherwise bare studio corner, its lens cap still fitted, a thin layer of dust visible across the top plate, two neatly coiled cables resting beside the tripod legs, a plain gray wall behind, no people, the camera filling most of the frame.

legibility.why: One object fills the frame with nothing else competing for resolution.

reexpress.why: The overlay states a consequence of the no-camera mechanic rather than repeating the title's own phrasing.
